item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. As the monsoon being gradually replaced by a relatively humid easterly airstream in the latter part of this week, there will be mist over the coast of Guangdong. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas early next week, it will become cool and windier over the region.
